_comment: Shared look: font roles, named colours, and elements shown on every page (clock, page number, progress bar). Positions: x = left|center|right|pixels, y = pixels|bottom|bottom-N (baseline convention, N from screen edge).

colors._comment: R,G,B. status text (ok/alert) is picked automatically by service state.

progress._comment: Full-width page-dwell loading bar across the top edge.
